body:
## Problem

Validation used an unauthenticated standalone JSON cache, rebuilt and froze the base-plus-example dataset for every miss, and did not preserve all typed failure evidence consistently between live and cached findings.

## Result

- Bind cached complete verdicts to the admitted optimized producer plus exact implementation, repository, selected-input, shape, and toolchain identities in the shared action store.
- Reuse one base projection and one prepared shape analysis, then evaluate examples through borrowed composite dataset views with complete-target semantics.
- Preserve failure class, documented terms, guidance, provenance, and source quads across cold and warm paths.
- Record phase-separated work for the current execution; cache hits never replay old work telemetry.
- Remove downstream RDF union/count tests whose engine behavior is owned by PurRDF.

This advances #1745 and follows Principles 4, 7, and 18.

## Validation

- `make fmt`
- `make lint`
- Focused synthetic nextest selection: 9/9 passed, covering cache key boundaries, corruption failure, typed evidence retention, exact producer selection, remote dependency invalidation, and canonical-subsumption targets.
- `make check CHECK_ARGS="--timings-json dist/check-timings-1745.json"`: lint passed and the optimized pipeline producer built in 36m34s. The gate then failed on current repository-static findings tracked with acceptance criteria in #1761 and #1762. The still-running sync sibling was interrupted after the gate had irrecoverably failed.
title: perf: reuse authenticated validation state

Closes #1191

## Summary

Derives closed-world **validation shapes** as a first-class *derived* object from the constraint-bearing axioms already authored in each slice (V1 of the SHACL/ShEx-as-projections program). `logic:` is canonical; SHACL/ShEx are lossy projections of one `ValidationShapeIr` (P17/P4), lowered once so the two surfaces cannot drift.

### What lands
- **R2 — full closed-world OWL fragment.** `frontend::derive_validation_shapes` now covers `rdfs:domain`/`rdfs:range`, `owl:Functional`/`InverseFunctionalProperty`, `some`/`allValuesFrom`, `owl:hasValue`, `owl:disjointWith`/`complementOf`/named `AllDisjointClasses`, `owl:oneOf`, and unqualified + qualified cardinality — accumulated **one shape per target** (`Class` / `SubjectsOf` / `ObjectsOf`) so a class/property carrying several axioms merges into one shape. ~3420 shapes over the corpus.
- **R1 — IR + projection.** New `ShapeTarget::{SubjectsOf,ObjectsOf}`, `ConstraintComponent::{HasValue,QualifiedValueShape,Not}`, inverse-path + `sh:severity`/`sh:message` on `PropertyConstraintIr`, node-level `node_components` + `label` on `ValidationShapeIr` — every new field folded into the content key **append-only / non-default-only**, so a shape-free (and the historical openEHR) `LogicProgram`'s content-addressed key stays byte-identical. SHACL + ShEx projection arms for every new form, with honest per-target ShEx residue.
- **R3 — closure selector.** Generalized the contract-level `closure_entries` into a per-property/per-class **closed-world-reading opt-out**, reusing `logic:closureEntry`/`ClosureValue`/`OpenWorldClosure` verbatim (no new shape DSL). Default is derive-all (MAXIMAL UTILITY); an axiom marked `OpenWorldClosure` derives no shape.
- **R5 — design fork.** Dataset-derive (read the merged authored `Dataset`), recorded in `LOGIC-VALIDATION.md`.
- **Parity / subsumption.** `frame_shapes` now routes its constraint data through `ValidationShapeIr` (a frame render-mode reproduces `frame-shapes.ttl` byte-for-byte); `result_shapes`' `sh:sparql` procedural column contracts are proven subsumed by the declarative model at the contract level (a content test), keeping the canonical IR free of raw SPARQL. Both byte-oracles stay green.

### Faithfulness (P17 "ValidationOnly, never over-claim")
- `owl:someValuesFrom` projects to the **class-membership under-approximation** (bare `sh:class`, vacuous when absent), not an existential `qualifiedMinCount` that would false-positive on the ontology's own open-world value individuals.
- A universal-top range/domain (`rdfs:Resource`) is vacuous → no node constraint.

### Dogfooded R3 opt-outs
Seven `OpenWorldClosure` opt-outs for genuinely open-world axioms whose closed-world reading over-claims: six `rdfs:range` properties over external/reasoner-inferred ranges (`projectionFunction`, `wasGeneratedBy`, `processFunction`, `constraintFunction`, `unit`, `bcp47Tag`), and the kernel top-sortal `gmeow:Agent` disjointness (a TBox integrity axiom enforced by the native DL coherence gate, not a data-shape). `make validate` = **0 errors**.

### Gate reconciliation
- The illustrative open-world example corpus is recorded in the `example_sweep` `NON_CONFORMANT` allowlist (examples don't close the world for the new domain/range/disjointness fragment).
- `fail.nq` fixtures now yield 8 errors + 1 warning (the new domain/range/disjointness shapes correctly flag more); goldens re-blessed.
- The budget-exempt whole-bundle coherence-gate nextest slow-timeout was raised (the whole-720k-quad DL chase cost from the merged kernel top-sortal partition — not shape volume; SHACL shapes are a sidecar, not in the reasoned dataset).

### Verification
`make check` green (validate 0 errors; 3860 rust tests pass, all under the 25s budget; check-generated / lint / example_sweep / coherence-gate all green). Built on `origin/main` merged in.
title: feat(logic): derive the full closed-world validation-shape fragment from slice constraint axioms

body:
Closes #1304

## Summary

Subsumes the embedded Scryer Prolog backward oracle into the native logic engine for the recursive/cyclic backward fragment — **per the issue's binding redirect: a subsumptive demand-transformation rewrite over the existing semi-naive core, NOT a new SLG engine** (magic-sets and tabling are the same Backward Fixpoint Procedure, Bry 1990). The variant magic-set keying is upgraded to **subsumptive** keying (Tekle & Liu, SIGMOD 2011), the three backward-dispatch consumers are promoted to the native engine under per-consumer Scryer parity gates, and inference budgets transfer unchanged through the single `StepGovernor` committed-derivation point.

Engine-only promotion: no new `logic:`→Prolog projection artifact and no loss-ledger preservation-judgment change (P17/P18). Zero new Python. `make check` green on the branch merged with current `main`.

## Changes

- **Shared arity-generic `BindingPattern` subsumption lattice** (`physical/binding_pattern.rs`) replaces the binary-only `Adorn` (removed, no shim). `subsumes`/`meet`/`join` (A⊑B iff bound(A)⊆bound(B)); consumed by both the demand keying (`magic.rs`) and the forward query-plan match-plan (`generic.rs`).
- **N-ary backward resolution**: `resolve_native` dual-paths on arity — binary goals stay byte-identical on the seminaive+magic path (arithmetic builtins intact); n-ary goals resolve through the arity-generic evaluator over the generic-triple encoding (`triple(s,p,o,w)`, predicate-as-data), which the binary store structurally cannot express. Demand provenance flows through.
- **Stratified negation-as-failure** on the backward surface (`QBodyLit::Neg`, `\+`/`not`) — a direct Scryer subsumption. Sound magic transform under negation; a demand-induced non-stratifiable transform falls back to sound full base materialization with an honest `preservation` downgrade (`CompleteOver`). Explicit gaps route to the oracle: `Unsupported(Floundering)` (unbound negative call), `Unsupported(NonStratifiable)` (genuinely non-stratifiable base).
- **Single-governor budgets + termination guard**: backward budgets charge at the single `StepGovernor` committed-derivation point (deterministic exhaustion, incomplete-never-wrong sound prefix). A value-generating-recursion guard flags a rule in an IDB cycle whose arithmetic `is`-generator reaches the head with no finite driver → unbudgeted returns `Unsupported(NonTerminatingArithmetic)` (never hangs); the finite-driver `len`-over-rdf-lists recursion stays decided. n-ary generic budgets cut via `materialize_generic_budgeted` (forward path byte-identical).
- **Subsumptive demand transformation** (the headline): per predicate, keep only the ⊑-minimal (most-general) demanded adornment antichain and serve every more-specific demand from it. Answer sets **byte-identical** (residual discharged by the original body atoms + goal projection; derived set stays a subset of the untransformed least model). New `DemandProfile` exposes the structural collapse ratio.
- **Consumer promotions, per-consumer parity gates (gap-zero)**:
  - `sparql_path_lower` swapped off `backward_oracle()` onto `resolve_native` — one Scryer production caller removed. native ≡ Scryer over every lowerable property-path operator on acyclic + cyclic graphs (60 comparisons).
  - `counterfactual` (already native-first via `dispatch_query`) gated: recursive fragment native ≡ Scryer gap-zero; n-ary decides; cut demotes honestly.
  - `profile_gate` cut-confinement gate: native declines cut (`Unsupported(Cut)`, no soft-cut), oracle decides, `check_cut_profile` transfers unchanged.
- **Termination parity**: native terminates and matches Scryer's tabling on left-/right-recursive cyclic IDB; on left-recursion native ≡ Scryer while the path-memo reference-SLD under-produces (native 9 vs reference 3) — proving native subsumes the incomplete reference on exactly the fragment the issue targets.

## Verification

- `make check` green (Rust tests, clippy, validate, reason-crosscheck, drift gate, 86 pytest) on the branch merged with current `main`.
- 1031 `gmeow-logic` lib tests green; all Scryer/reference-SLD parity gates green.
- Projection-invariant: the only post-regenerate change is the merge=ours `gmeow.gts` re-mint; demand IRIs and all new engine symbols appear in zero committed artifacts.

## Scope notes (honest record)

- **Stratified negation** was not in the original plan's Task 3 (which framed re-stratify as a defensive guard and declined a negation transform on the premise "the query IR carries no negation"). It was added deliberately as a genuine Scryer-subsumption capability (reachable via the production query parser), sound and fully tested — the declined-T4 note is now superseded by the negation being present.
- **`ProfileVerdict`** (a planned demotion-reason enum) was dropped as redundant: `resolve_native` already returns the reason as `UnsupportedKind` (Cut/Arithmetic/NonBinaryAtom/NonStratifiable/Floundering/NonTerminatingArithmetic).
- Cut/procedural stays oracle-only (constitutional, P17 — audited under #1305). This unblocks the Scryer deletion dossier (#1430) and feeds the engine-vs-engine benchmark (#1420).
title: feat(logic): native subsumptive-demand backward resolution + budget/parity-gated consumer promotion (subsumes Scryer)

## Summary

Adds a fourth structural kind under `gmeow:Location` for astronomical and space-domain entities, plus coordinate frames, value vocabularies, and IVOA/UAT alignments.

- **`CelestialLocation`** (SubKind of Location) — stars, galaxies, nebulae, planets, asteroids, comets, spacecraft, clusters. Kinds are open value individuals (`CelestialObjectType`), not subclasses (Principle 9).
- **`CelestialCoordinates`** (Kind, sibling to GeoCoordinates/SpatialCoordinates) — RA, Dec, and epoch as frame-relative scalars (Principle 11).
- **`CelestialReferenceOrigin`** (value vocabulary) — topocentric, geocentric, barycentric, heliocentric. Aligned to IVOA `refposition`.
- **`hasTimeScale`** on `ReferenceFrame` — uses existing `TimeScale` individuals from `temporal.ttl`, aligned to IVOA `timescale` (Principle 4: one canonical source).
- 4 seed reference frames: CelestialEquatorial, ICRS, FK5, Galactic.
- IVOA refframe / refposition / object-type and UAT alignments in `places.ttl`; IVOA timescale alignments in `temporal.ttl`.
- 7 structural guard tests + documentation in `docs/location-mapping.md`.

## Test Plan

- [x] `make check` passes (lint, validate, compile-check, reason ELK+HermiT, verify, tests)
- [x] `make compile-mappings` + `make compile-check` — no drift
- [x] `make export` — `llms.txt` regenerated
- [x] 705 pytest tests pass

## Design notes

- `CelestialCoordinates` is a sibling Kind to `SpatialCoordinates`, not a subclass, to respect gUFO's identity principle (one Kind per endurant).
- `ReferencePosition` already exists in `temporal.ttl` as a `gufo:Kind`; the celestial origin vocabulary is named `CelestialReferenceOrigin` to avoid stereotype conflict.
- `TimeScale` already exists in `temporal.ttl`; no duplicate `Timescale` value vocabulary was created.

Closes #85

body:
Closes #1377

## Summary

Delivers the remaining **GMN-1 ecosystem surface** (S6 of EPIC #1371) after auditing the shipped core. GMN-1 is framed as **one graph-derived `lang:Notation` with N typed views**, each a comorphism out of the single glyph signature (`gmnFixity`/`gmnPrecedence`/`gmnArity` + `lang:Denotation`), bound by a cross-surface **coherence law**. Everything is graph-derived and byte-deterministic — no hardcoded glyph/symbol tables. Rust-first, zero Python.

**Scope reconciliation (user-approved):** the GMN-1 codec/writer/parser, round-trip gate, validator tier, conformance vectors, `gmeow gmn` CLI, and the `Gmn1Target` registry entry already shipped on `main` via later issues (#1441/#1475/#1510/#1579). This PR **audits** those against #1377's exact acceptance criteria (adding executable teeth) and builds the genuinely-remaining ecosystem.

## What's in it (one commit per task)
- **Audit + teeth** — denotation-removal graph-derived test, `@patch`/`@retract` effective-view resolver, UTS#39 confusable-freeness inventory gate.
- **`lang:Notation` + coherence law** — `all_notation_views_agree_on_one_canonical_tree` (all 4 grammar formalisms + codec parse to ONE canonical `RuleExpr`).
- **Version machinery** — artifacts keyed under the graph-resolved `gmn1/v<major>/`; out-of-window headers rejected; migration executor over authored correspondence legs (non-vacuous demonstrator, hard-fail on unbridged glyph drop); version-provenance tagging.
- **GBNF + Lark** — real constrained-decode artifacts (Exact round-trip via char-class hex escapes), per-formalism blocking → honest `SoundUnder`, never a fabricated artifact.
- **Token metrics** — a 7-vector `math:`-grounded `gmeow:Measurement`; the flagship `GMN < Turtle` claim gated on the **sound byte-fallback bound** (14,027 < 23,695), not naive chars/4.
- **Verbalizer** — GMN↔controlled-NL `lang:translationCorrespondence` with an injectivity guard (measured Exact).
- **Consume-path security-ring filter** — `gmeow gmn project --ring` computes the Denning `gmnRingWithin` product-order from coordinates; out-of-ring leakage hard-fails (`lang:GmnRingLeak`). *(closes adversary F2)*
- **Proof-carrying training corpus** — new registered stage (3-place edge); deterministically enumerated well-typed terms, 5-verifier rejection sampling (parse/roundtrip/typecheck/proof-obligation/ring), acceptance certificate per kept pair. Corpus only, no training.
- **MCP tools** — `gmn_validate` / `gmn_expand` / `gmn_explain` (with NL gloss), checkout-free off the bundle.
- **~500-token primer + teachability gate** — graph-derived card in llms.txt/full + MCP resource; held-out fixture + primer-completeness + AST-validity gate operationalizes EPIC scenario 7. *(closes adversary F1)*
- **WASM validator** — `gmn_validate` entrypoint embedding the codebook (rejects unknown glyphs, not just syntax); reasoner-free; `make wasm` purity extended.
- **Off-gate token-cost matrix** — 5 tokenizer families (o200k/cl100k embedded, Qwen vendored, Llama/Gemma fetched-at-maint — restricted licenses never vendored into this AGPL tree), flags byte-fragmenting glyphs.
- **Whole-ecosystem `pack_root`** — folds gbnf/lark/metrics/verbalization digests so `gmeow gmn verify` certifies every surface as one tamper-evident identity.
- **Docs** — PIPELINE_SPINE §6.1, projections.md, README, mcp-server.md; PR #1626 auto-extension note posted.

## Declined (design decisions, not deferrals)
- **Generic `gmn` transcode codec (#3)** — ruled out per LANG-GMN.md; the registry is the sole seam.
- The full logic-operator plane (#1373 / PR #1626) is graph-auto-covered with **zero code change** when it lands (all surfaces are graph-derived) — recorded on #1626.

## Verification
`make check` is green on every substantive gate (sync, validate, crate-check, reason-verify, coherence-gate-teeth, check-lint, coverage, constitution-check, slice-quality-gate, wikidata, acceptance) and the full test suite. Local rust-gate flagged only two **#1377-unrelated** slow tests (`rollup_targets_are_real_translation_units`, `slice_brief::run_is_deterministic`) timing out under heavy shared-machine load — they pass under normal load and on CI's dedicated runner.

**Known upstream boundary:** the CI `wasm` job is red repo-wide because purrdf `rust-v0.8.2` (pinned on `main`) has a 32-bit `usize` const-overflow in its JSON-LD codec that breaks all `wasm32` builds — not this PR's code; the GMN wasm validator is host-verified + `cargo tree`-purity-verified and builds green once purrdf is fixed on `main`.
title: feat(1377): GMN-1 ecosystem — one graph-derived notation, N typed views (grammars, primer, MCP, metrics, verbalizer, proof-carrying corpus, WASM, versioning)

## Done (green, tested, in gmeow.gts)
- **Constraint IR + lift + recover + projections for all 6 node-kind families** — `OptConstraintIr` (quantity, occurrences/existence cardinality, ordinal/coded-text value sets, datetime, string patterns, terminology bindings); `lift_opt_to_validation_shape` → `logic:ValidationShapeIr` (the once-dead `NodeKind::ValidationShape`, now live); `recover_opt_from_shape` inverse ⇒ **`recover∘lift = id`** per family.

- **General #1191 OWL-restriction derivation → gmeow.gts.** I built AND compiled a `extract_validation_shapes` that derives shapes from `owl:someValuesFrom` restrictions, but discovered `compile_logic` parses only `slices/core/logic/module.ttl` (the logic: vocabulary) — the 268 domain `owl:Restriction` axioms live in the OTHER slices and reach `gmeow.gts` via `source_load`'s merged base graph, NOT the logic: frontend. Firing the derivation on the merged ontology needs a new merged-ontology derivation stage; I reverted the incomplete wiring rather than commit code that produces 0 shapes in production.
- **Datetime/ordinal OPT readers** — the IR/lift/projections cover them, but the vendored OPT has no such constraint to read; needs a fixture.
- **The #1197 cluster** — migrating the 15 authored `slices/**/shapes.ttl` to projections, sealing the purity gate's shape half, and retiring `export.rs::write_shex` — coupled to the merged-ontology derivation above; not started.

#1195 stays open. 13 commits; ~65 tests.
title: feat(1195): openEHR constraints axis — validation-shape IR + SHACL projection + OPT→logic: lift with u∘d=id law

Closes #727. Advances #630 (the RDF-1.2-first Rust-reasoning-authority epic, workstream #1 of #672), #654 (canonical Finding model), and #629 (rdflib removal — native-reasoning-path slice).

## Summary
A Python→Rust cutover that unifies the native extensions, eliminates the surviving `Rust→Python→Rust` round-trip seams, and completes the #727 deletion of the Python logic-compiler duplicate. Everything stays Docker-free / Java-free / nightly-Rust.

## Changes (one commit per piece)
1. **Unify 5 native PyO3 extensions into one `gmeow_native` cdylib.** `gmeow_rdf`/`diagnostics`/`shacl`/`validate`/`logic` are now submodules of a single cdylib, so `PyReport`/`Finding` are **one shared type** process-wide. Previously each statically-linked cdylib had its own copy, raising `TypeError: 'Report' object is not an instance of 'Report'` whenever a report crossed module boundaries (which is why the old code funneled everything through JSON strings). Legacy import names (`import gmeow_validate`, …) are preserved unchanged via `sys.modules` shims — zero churn at the ~60 call sites.
2. **Eliminate the diagnostics JSON round-trip.** With the shared type, `validate_all_native` and `verify_native` now hand Python a **live `Report`** pyclass; Python folds its filesystem-bound lints (guide-anchor, i18n PO, test-DSL) straight in and renders SARIF/JSON/HTML directly — no `serialize → from_json → to_json` loop. Removed the dead `report_json()` / `Report.from_json`.
3. **Complete #727 — Rust logic compiler is the sole authority.** Deleted the ~3.8k-line Python compiler duplicate (`logic_projections`/`logic_frontend`/`logic_ir`/`logic_adapter`.py) + 5 redundant Python test modules; `logic_runner` drives `gmeow_logic.compile_logic` (extended with `nemo_rules` + `preservation_ledger` keys). Inverted the "faithful port of …py" comments (Rust is the source now). **Conformance/parity goldens unchanged & green.**
4. **Fuse `materialize` + `explain`** into one native `materialize_explained` call — removes the payload-rebuild + second FFI crossing on the conformance path.
5. **Remove rdflib from the native reasoning path** (`native_rl`, `logic_runner`) via the `gmeow_rdf` kernel (RDFC-1.0 canonical compare, raw-N-Quads input feed). A thin `native_rl_rdflib` adapter keeps rdflib-based callers working. The classic-cross-check **oracle** modules (`engine_crosscheck`, `rl_agreement`, `reasoning_cases`) intentionally **retain** rdflib/owlrl by design (#666).
6. **Repoint constitution gate citations** that #727's deletion left dangling (`governance/constitution.ttl` cited the removed Python files) to the authoritative Rust crate sources.

## Verification
- `cargo nextest run` — **621 passed** (incl. #817's new proptests, after rebase onto main).
- `make validate`, `reason-native`, `verify`, `audit`, `coverage`, `acceptance` — green.
- `constitution-check` ✓ and `check-generated` ✓ (no drift, no orphans).
- `mypy --strict` clean; `clippy -D warnings` clean; pre-commit clean.
- Conformance + projection **goldens byte-identical / isomorphic** — none edited.
- Branch rebased onto `origin/main` (linear history). Full `-n auto` pytest sweep runs in CI.
title: feat(630): Python→Rust cutover — unify native extensions, kill round-trip seams, fold #727

Closes #319.

## Summary

This PR delivers the `music-package` GTS profile and a standalone projection toolchain for turning frame-relative canonical music data into common notation formats and back.

## What changed

- **GTS-SPEC §13.4**: documented the `music-package` quad shape, projections, manifest, and verification rules.
- **Canonical model** (`src/gmeow_tools/ext/music/model.py`): `Piece` → `Voice` → `ToneEvent`, with pitch in cents and durations as `Fraction`s in the voice’s `beat_unit`.
- **Renderers** (`src/gmeow_tools/ext/music/serializers/`): MusicXML, MEI, tablature, LilyPond, ABC, Scala `.scl`, MIDI, Humdrum **kern, mensural, and graphic.
- **Importer**: MusicXML → `Piece` via `music21`, with extension lint that rejects non-MusicXML inputs.
- **CLI**: public `gmeow music render|import` dispatcher plus the `gmeow-music` entry point.
- **Declared-loss manifests**: every outward projection emits a Turtle sidecar; inward MusicXML import emits a PROV provenance sidecar.
- **Mapping compiler**: added the music-slice projection profiles (`jams`, `lrmoo`, `mo`, `pon`) so generated EDOAL/SPARQL artifacts are produced for them.
- **Tests** (`tests/test_music_package_projection.py`): GTS round-trip, MusicXML/music21 parse, `.scl` format, ABC round-trip, loss-manifest completeness, import provenance & lint.
- **Demo**: `scripts/music_five_minute_demo.py` + `docs/music-five-minute-demo.md`.

## Verification

- `make check` passes (lint, validate, ELK reasoning, verify, tests).
- `make test` passes: 2699 passed, 5 skipped.
- Demo script runs end-to-end and round-trips 8 notes through MusicXML.

## Principles

- Principle 4 (one canonical source): all generated artifacts are produced by `make regenerate` from canonical sources; no hand-edited generated files.
- Principle 9 (co-equal / non-privileged): enharmonic pitch spellings are projections, not canonical values.
- Principle 11 (directional, lossy notation): every renderer writes a manifest declaring its losses.
- Principle 12 (transforms are solver-layer): durations are frame-relative and converted at render time.
- Principle 13 (base CLI stays useful): `gmeow music` dispatches to the optional `gmeow-music` tool.
title: feat: GTS music-package profile & projection toolchain (#319)
